files.Title: Votanic.VXR2.Core.Input.Processors.CoordinateRemapProcessor
files.Summary:
Remaps coordinate system axes to Unity's coordinate system (Right=+X, Up=+Y, Forward=+Z, Left-Handed). Define which source axes map to Unity's Right/Up/Forward to convert between coordinate systems.

Uses direct matrix transformation:

  • For Vector3: v' = C * v (where C is the conversion matrix)
  • For Quaternion: M' = C * M * C^T (similarity transform on rotation matrix)

The conversion matrix and its transpose are computed once on first use and cached for performance. The matrix is built from axis mappings where each column represents where Unity's axis comes from in the source coordinate system. Handedness is automatically handled via matrix determinant (det=-1 indicates handedness flip).

Parameters: right, up, forward (axis mappings like "+x", "-y", "+z", etc.)

files.Title: Votanic.VXR2.Entity.VXRBaseEntity
files.Summary:
Base class for XR entities that manages tracking, positioning, and rotation within the VotanicXR system.

VXRBaseEntity provides core functionality for entities that can be tracked in XR space, including:

  • Tracking state management (IsTracking, Position, Rotation)
  • Input binding through action bindings
  • Lost tracking behavior handling (Stay, Default, CustomLocation)
  • Entity lifecycle management (Awake, Enable, Disable, Destroy)
  • Centralized entity registry for bulk updates

Derived classes should override Setup() to customize initialization and the input action event methods (IsTrackedInputActionEvent, PositionInputActionEvent, RotationInputActionEvent) to handle specific tracking data.

The entity maintains both raw tracking data and applies transformations based on the current tracking mode and lost tracking configuration from entityData.
